verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms docs.gladia.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the docs. Pages are also served as Markdown (.md), and each Markdown page tells agents to fetch the full documentation index at llms.txt, so the docs are clearly built for agent consumption. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no independent or community confirmation of agents using these docs in practice.
